<p class="eyebrow">Psychometrics &mdash; Data Science &mdash;  NLP &mdash; systems biology &mdash; integrable systems</p>

# Structure, wherever you <em>look for it</em>

<p class="lede">I'm Christopher Ormerod. I work at the point where language models, biological networks, and the symmetries of discrete dynamical systems turn out to be asking the same kinds of questions.</p>

<p class="role"><b>Executive Director of Natural Language Measurement</b>, College Board &middot; Co-chair, <a href="https://www.ncme-aime.org">NCME&nbsp;AIME</a></p>
